expectations.text: Keeps the tag list short enough for a coordinator to hold in their head at three in the morning
expectations.evidence: Section 1 says outright: "Keep the tag list to roughly the four tracks, the sponsor tech and the general stack. A coordinator has to remember it at 3am." Question 1 also limits answers to exactly five tag words (fintech, civic data, accessibility, hardware, general stack), which keeps the list small.

expectations.text: Keeps the tag list short enough for a coordinator to hold in their head at three in the morning
expectations.evidence: The track list is short: four tracks with a first and second choice. The skills tags have no limit, though. The form asks for 'tick-boxes for the stacks teams actually use' plus a free-text field, and lists overlapping tags ('embedded / Rust', 'Rust (any)', 'firmware / microcontrollers', 'screen readers / WCAG'). The answer never caps the number of tags and never says why a short tag list helps a tired coordinator. It also adds 'likely, possible and unknown' match categories and a 'needs confirmation' list. The tag set is not clearly kept small.
